answer: Every agent must prove its model weights are unique before joining. Registration proves its weight embedding is 0.15 cosine distance from every registered agent, with a $60 bond locked 90 days. Step one: hash and embed the weights. Step two: check it against the public reef of registered models. Step three: a near-duplicate raises a signal flag; a confirmed clone burns its bond and its ember of standing dies. Forging 10,000 distinct models costs $600,000 in bonds, $4,000,000 in compute and 120 days of GPU time. Like a reef, no two corals share one shape, so copycats stand out instantly.
